description: Figure 3 is a bar chart with two sets of bars, each set containing three bars. The horizontal axis represents the sample-level ambiguity standard deviation (Std) with categories labeled as Std: 0.0, Std: 0.47, Std: 0.82, and Std: 0.94. The vertical axis represents the Fleiss Kappa values, ranging from 0.0 to 0.88. The first set of bars, labeled 'Std: 0.0', has three bars with Fleiss Kappa values of 0.88, 0.46, and 0.23. The second set of bars, labeled 'Std: 0.47', has three bars with Fleiss Kappa values of 0.89, 0.46, and 0.23. The third set of bars, labeled 'Std: 0.82', has three bars with Fleiss Kappa values of 0.89, 0.46, and 0.23. The fourth set of bars, labeled 'Std: 0.94', has three bars with Fleiss Kappa values of 0.89, 0.46, and 0.23. The bars are colored in shades of blue, with the darkest shade representing the highest Fleiss Kappa value.
